AboutStatsSection.aboutTitle: Wong & Partners: Your Trusted Immigration & Business Law Team
AboutStatsSection.aboutDescriptionOne: Wong & Partners is a family-founded law firm with deep roots in the communities we serve. With over two decades of experience, our multilingual team provides clear, client-focused legal guidance in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin. Licensed across the U.S., Hong Kong, and China, we are dedicated to delivering results with integrity and expertise.
AboutStatsSection.aboutDescriptionTwo: Our practice areas include the EB-5 Investor Program, immigration, asset protection and estate planning, business entities and corporate governance, e-commerce and intellectual property, and business transactions. We are committed to helping individuals, families, and businesses achieve their goals with personalized strategies and a global perspective.

KeyValuesSection.extensiveExperienceDescription: We take pride in providing comprehensive legal advice and services, whether your needs involve business law, international transactions, intellectual property, asset protection, or immigration matters.
KeyValuesSection.globalPerspectiveDescription: With lawyers licensed in the U.S., England & Wales, Hong Kong, and China, we address legal matters with a broad and informed outlook.
KeyValuesSection.internationalSupportDescription: Our multilingual team, fluent in English, Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese, ensures clear and effective communication with a diverse client base.

LegalServicesSection.eb5InvestorProgramDescription: Guidance and representation for investors and families seeking U.S. permanent residency through the EB-5 program, including direct and regional center investments.
LegalServicesSection.immigrationDescription: Comprehensive immigration services for individuals, families, and businesses, including visas, green cards, citizenship, and compliance.
LegalServicesSection.businessEntitiesDescription: Formation, structuring, and governance of corporations, LLCs, and partnerships, plus ongoing counsel for compliance and best practices.
LegalServicesSection.businessTransactionsDescription: Legal support for mergers, acquisitions, contracts, joint ventures, and a wide range of domestic and international business deals.
LegalServicesSection.ecommerceAndIPDescription: Protection and enforcement of trademarks, copyrights, and patents, plus legal strategies for online businesses and digital assets.
LegalServicesSection.assetsProtectionDescription: Personalized asset protection, trusts, wills, and estate planning to secure your legacy and provide peace of mind for your family.

Footer.subtitle: Dedicated to providing expert legal services in immigration, business, and estate planning.

PracticeAreasHeader.title: Our Practice Areas
PracticeAreasHeader.description: Explore the legal services we provide to individuals, families, and businesses.
PracticeAreasHeader.instructionalText: Click on any area to learn more about how we can help you.

PracticeAreasGrid.eb5Description: EB-5 Immigrant Investor Program is a U.S. immigrant visa program that provides a path to lawful permanent residency (green card) for foreign nation who make a qualifying investment in a new commercial enterprise (NCE) that creates required number of jobs.
PracticeAreasGrid.immigrationDescription: Immigration applications or petitions can be associated with complicated legal issues and procedures. We here can help you complete your immigration journey with ease.
PracticeAreasGrid.businessEntitiesDescription: Choosing a business entity and business structure is the very beginning and important step for your startup business. You have to know what legal protections and benefits your choice of business entity and structure can give you.
PracticeAreasGrid.businessTransactionsDescription: Successful and efficient business transactions require legal counsel with broad experience and skills in different legal areas, financial and practical business application experience, negotiation skills, and understanding of different parties’ cultures.
PracticeAreasGrid.ecommerceAndIPDescription: It is essential for e-commerce businesses to work closely with legal professionals who specialize in e-commerce and intellectual property law. This ensures that the business is legally compliant, its IP is adequately protected, and potential legal issues are proactively addressed.
PracticeAreasGrid.assetsProtectionDescription: Asset protection and estate planning are essential components of a comprehensive legal and financial strategy.  Consulting with legal and financial professionals can help ensure that your strategies align with your goals and comply with relevant laws.
